name: Spotting
description: Dots with a second, larger dot set among them at a wider pitch.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, #000 18%, transparent 18%) 0 0 / 16.67% 16.67%, radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, #000 34%, transparent 34%) 25% 25% / 50% 50%; mask: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, #000 18%, transparent 18%) 0 0 / 16.67% 16.67%, radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, #000 34%, transparent 34%) 25% 25% / 50% 50%; } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
